items.reason: The question is radiotherapy fractionation ('compare conventional radiotherapy of 60 Gy (6 weeks) versus hypofractionated radiotherapy of 40 Gy'). Temozolomide is identical in both arms ('concurrent (75 mg/m2/day qd) and adjuvant (6 cycles)'), so it is soc_backbone and not an established-therapy experiment. R1 ties established_therapy_only to an established drug that is itself the subject (rule 6), which is not the case here. The manual does not define the three S6 reasons, so established_therapy_only (the only drug is an established GBM therapy) is also defensible.

note: D31-C1 settles the S6 reason: excluded_intervention_type (RT fractionation is the tested intervention; temozolomide is soc_backbone in both arms). D31-A8: the known-MGMT-status requirement is testing, not selection, so MGMT is exploratory_correlative and any_molecular_selection is false (consistent with NCT04552977). Nothing pending for XL.

revisions.reason: The tested intervention is a radiotherapy schedule ('60 Gy in 30 fractions' vs '40.05 Gy in 15 fractions'), with temozolomide identical in both arms.
D31-C1: an RT schedule is under test, so the S6 reason is excluded_intervention_type.

'known o6-methylguanine-DNA-methyltransferase promoter methylation status' requires testing with no required value, so MGMT is exploratory_correlative; the only other requirement is the CNS5 glioblastoma definition.
